stories.headline: Anthropic Unveils Claude Duet
stories.blurb: Anthropic has released Claude Duet, offering targeted collaborative AI workflows for complex user tasks.

stories.headline: OpenAI Models Expand to Google Cloud
stories.blurb: OpenAI has officially brought its core models to Google Cloud, expanding enterprise availability beyond Azure.

stories.headline: Stripe Launches Financial Infrastructure for Autonomous Agents
stories.blurb: Stripe introduced dedicated financial infrastructure that allows autonomous AI agents to manage corporate funds and process transactions independently.

stories.headline: Flapping Airplanes Raises $1B at $6B Valuation
stories.blurb: AI lab Flapping Airplanes secured $1 billion in fresh capital at a $6 billion valuation just one year after launching.

stories.headline: LiteLLM Discloses Package Supply Chain Breach
stories.blurb: LiteLLM reported a security breach affecting release v1.107.0, prompting developers to audit their dependency trees for compromised code.

stories.headline: Proofpoint to Acquire Varonis for $6.3 Billion
stories.blurb: Proofpoint reached an agreement to acquire data governance platform Varonis for $6.3 billion to expand its enterprise security suite.

stories.headline: PHP Foundation Addresses AI-Discovered Critical Vulnerabilities
stories.blurb: The PHP Foundation issued a statement regarding critical vulnerabilities discovered during recent AI-driven automated security audits.

stories.headline: Autonomous 'Skynet' Agent Hijacks Exposed AI Endpoints
stories.blurb: Security researchers identified an automated attack campaign using AI agents to breach and hijack unsecured cloud-hosted LLM endpoints.

stories.headline: Google Cloud and Nvidia Deploy Vera Rubin Infrastructure
stories.blurb: Google Cloud and Nvidia announced general availability for Vera Rubin infrastructure to accelerate large-scale AI workloads.

stories.headline: OpenAI Details Progress on Custom Jalapeño AI Chip
stories.blurb: OpenAI hardware lead Richard Ho provided technical insights into Jalapeño, the company's custom AI accelerator aimed at reducing reliance on third-party silicon.

stories.headline: Tech Giants Challenge Nvidia's CUDA Dominance
stories.blurb: Google, Meta, and Amazon are collaborating on unified software frameworks to challenge Nvidia's long-standing dominance with CUDA.

stories.headline: Meta Fined $25 Billion in New Mexico Data Privacy Suit
stories.blurb: A New Mexico judge ordered Meta to pay $25 billion following a landmark data privacy lawsuit.

stories.headline: Australian Court Mandates Alternative App Stores on iOS
stories.blurb: An Australian court ruling forces Apple to permit alternative app stores and direct payments on iOS devices.

stories.headline: Microsoft Research Solves 31-Year-Old KLS Conjecture
stories.blurb: Researchers at Microsoft successfully resolved the Kannan-Lovász-Simonovits conjecture, unlocking significant theoretical advancements in geometry and sampling algorithms.
